# Results Directory

This directory stores evaluation results, plots, and analysis outputs.

## Generated Files

- `baseline_confusion_matrix.png` - Confusion matrix for baseline model
- `bert_confusion_matrix.png` - Confusion matrix for BERT
- `roberta_confusion_matrix.png` - Confusion matrix for RoBERTa
- `baseline_roc_curve.png` - ROC curve for baseline model
- `bert_roc_curve.png` - ROC curve for BERT
- `roberta_roc_curve.png` - ROC curve for RoBERTa
- `model_comparison.png` - Comparative visualization of all models
- `final_results.csv` - Summary metrics for all models
- `feature_importance.csv` - Feature importance for baseline model

## Viewing Results

All plots and CSVs will be saved here automatically during evaluation.
